_about: Where sound files may come from. 'ok' = commercial use incl. ads; 'organic' = organic posts only; 'credit' = credit line required in the caption/description; 'no' = never.

sources.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects (AI generated)
sources.notes: Generated by sfx.py with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. Check your plan's commercial terms.

sources.name: Pixabay Sound Effects
sources.notes: Pixabay Content License: commercial use, no credit. Don't resell the raw file.

sources.name: Mixkit Sound Effects
sources.notes: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License: commercial, no credit.

sources.name: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundle (2015–2026)
sources.notes: Royalty-free, commercial, no credit. Not for AI training.

sources.name: Freesound (CC0 filter only)
sources.notes: Only CC0 files. CC-BY = credit; CC-BY-NC = never.

sources.name: ZapSplat (Premium/Gold download)
sources.notes: No credit when downloaded on a paid plan.

sources.name: Epidemic Sound (business plan)
sources.notes: Only with an active business/commercial plan; personal plans are not for client work.

sources.name: Artlist SFX
sources.notes: Social plan covers monetized social posts, not ads; ads need a business plan.

sources.name: Envato Elements SFX
sources.notes: License each file to the project while subscribed.

sources.name: Instagram / TikTok in-app sounds
sources.notes: Trending and meme sounds (vine boom, bruh, etc.): add them in the app when posting, never baked into the file.

sources.name: BBC Sound Effects archive
sources.notes: RemArc license: non-commercial only. Paid license via Pro Sound Effects.
